meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14 — the standing law of the import pipeline
meta.note: Nathan's own words: 'I feed html files, they decide what to do with them, taking the best parts of them.'

law: Nathan feeds HTML. The agents decide. The best parts survive.

mechanics.desc: After deliberation, agents explicitly rank the import's elements by quanta/resonance and name the BEST PARTS — the strongest ideas, mechanics, patterns. Ranked list is part of the deliberation record.
Conversions are built FROM the best parts, not from the whole file. Each conversion proposal cites which best parts it carries forward and why they were chosen.
The agents choose the conversion type themselves (synthesis, build, curation, route, intelligence upgrade, or something new) — Nathan's gate approves, never prescribes.
What isn't chosen isn't kept raw — the condensed digest keeps the record, but only best parts get converted. No hoarding.
